Paramagnetic and d2sp3 hybridisation requires low spin configuration with t2g-filled? d2sp3 uses inner d orbitals, typical for low-spin complexes of d6-d8? For d2 metal (e.g., Mn2+ d5?) Not matching. Evaluate each:
- [Cr(NH3)6]3+: Cr3+ d3, weak field NH3 -> high spin, uses sp3d2, not d2sp3. Not.
- [Co(NH3)6]3+: Co3+ d6, NH3 moderate field, can be low spin (t2g6) with d2sp3. Low spin d6 is diamagnetic (all paired), not paramagnetic. High spin d6 would be paramagnetic (4 unpaired) but uses sp3d2. So not paramagnetic with d2sp3.
- [Cr(CN)6]3-: Cr2+? Actually charge -3 overall, CN- is -1 each, total -6, so Cr must be +3? 6*(-1)+Cr = -3 => Cr = +3. Cr3+ d3, CN- strong field -> low spin? d3 low spin still has 3 unpaired (t2g3), uses d2sp3? Strong field octahedral low spin uses d2sp3. So [Cr(CN)6]3- could be low spin d3 with d2sp3 and paramagnetic (3 unpaired). Likely.
- [Mn(CN)6]4-: CN- strong field, overall -4, 6*(-1)+Mn = -4 => Mn = +2. Mn2+ d5, strong field low spin d5 (t2g5) has 1 unpaired? Actually low spin d5 (t2g5) has 1 unpaired (all paired except one? t2g5 gives one unpaired). So paramagnetic with 1 unpaired, could use d2sp3. So candidate.
- [Fe(CN)6]3-: CN- strong field, overall -3, 6*(-1)+Fe = -3 => Fe = +3. Fe3+ d5, low spin d5 (t2g5) 1 unpaired, paramagnetic, could use d2sp3.
- [Cr(H2O)6]3+: Cr3+ d3, H2O weak field -> high spin, uses sp3d2, not d2sp3.
- [FeF6]3-: F- weak field, overall -3, 6*(-1)+Fe = -3 => Fe = +3. Fe3+ d5, weak field high spin (5 unpaired), uses sp3d2, not d2sp3.
Thus only complexes with strong field ligands (CN-) and low spin configuration could adopt d2sp3. Need also paramagnetic (unpaired electrons). Low spin d3 (Cr3+), low spin d5 (Mn2+, Fe3+) all have unpaired electrons (3,1,1 respectively). So candidates: [Cr(CN)6]3-, [Mn(CN)6]4-, [Fe(CN)6]3-. All three are paramagnetic and likely use inner orbital (d2sp3) hybridisation. However need to check if low spin indeed uses d2sp3; for octahedral complexes, inner orbital (low spin) uses d2sp3, outer orbital (high spin) uses sp3d2. So yes. Therefore total number of species that are paramagnetic and have d2sp3 hybridisation = 3.
